routing_warnings.description: The message reports that legitimate pages and posts were moved to trash and the site appeared blank; this is evidence for page and layout recovery, not removal of injected spam content.
The explicit removal claim concerns 37 malicious backdoors; the message does not explicitly claim that the malware-generated spam posts were removed.
The unresolved page and post status concerns legitimate-content recovery rather than explicitly establishing the status of unauthorized-content removal.
